title: APPROVE the Resolution in Attachment A that: A. AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) or their designee to claim $45,745,590 in fiscal year (FY)…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0497, Program]
[FINANCE, BUDGET, AND AUDIT COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (3-0):]
APPROVE the Resolution in Attachment A that:

A.	AUTHORIZE the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) or their designee to claim $45,745,590 in fiscal year (FY) 2026-27 State of Good Repair Program (SGR) grant funds as the Regional Entity for Los Angeles County for this program;

B.	APPROVE the regional SGR Project List for FY2026-27 in Attachment B; and

C.	CERTIFY that Metro will comply with all conditions and requirements set forth in the SB1 SGR Certification and Assurances document, applicable statutes, regulations and guidelines.
summary: Metro would claim about $45.7 million in state of good repair grant funds for fiscal 2026-27, approve the regional project list for that money, and certify that it will follow state conditions.

details.action: grant claim and project list approval
